interpolate_aria_pose: interpolate a PoseSE3 from a closed-loop trajectory at a given capture timestamp in nanoseconds
process_frame: process an AriaFrame by undistorting the image and saving the rectified output to disk
read_frames_from_metadata: read a transforms.json metadata file and return a list of AriaFrame dataclass objects
storePly: store a point cloud with xyz coordinates and rgb colors to a PLY file on disk
project: project 3D world points into 2D image coordinates using a camera pose and intrinsic matrix
